fusions.name: Covey Rise
fusions.desc: Bursts upward, dealing 11 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and knocking them back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Skittering Kick
fusions.desc: A leaping kick at a target up to 5 tiles away for 4 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at the full 5 tiles.

fusions.name: Bolt for the Treeline
fusions.desc: Bolts you 5 tiles forward, and you move 20% faster for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Startle Reflex
fusions.desc: Each time you are hurt by anything other than fire, a shield worth 10% of your maximum health closes over you for 3 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
